text: > **Process (mandatory):** this is money-handling code — get a **codex problem/solution design first** (crate module layout + the journal/saga/trail split) before implementing. Work in an **isolated worktree**, branch + **PR** (never push master). Scope tests to `cargo test -p nmp-wallet -p nmp-nip60` plus `cargo test -p nmp-testing --test doctrine_lint_smoke`; do **not** run `cargo test --workspace`. Run **codex review on your diff before opening the PR**; promote any actionable findings to a GitHub issue and discard the review artifact (never commit it). Open a ready-for-review PR (TLDR + detailed overview + tradeoffs), reference #2864, clean up the worktree when done. [...] > **Process:** money-handling code → get a **codex problem/solution design first** for the journal/saga/trail split before implementing. Scope tests to `cargo test -p nmp-wallet -p nmp-nip60` + `cargo test -p nmp-testing --test doctrine_lint_smoke`; never `--workspace`. **codex review before PR**; promote findings to issues, discard the artifact. Keep it on the existing PR #2871 (move it out of draft when ready) rather than opening a competing PR; clean up the worktree when done. [...] Two notes on the prompt: I deliberately **narrowed "all this work" to the spine** — Phase 1 in one PR would be a huge, hard-to-review money-handling change, and the epic already lists the other Phase-1 items as separate checkboxes. If you'd rather one agent own the *entire* Phase 1 vertically, say so and I'll broaden it — but I'd recommend the spine-first slice. Also, want me to actually dispatch this agent now (background, isolated worktree), or are you handing the prompt off yourself? [...] **Coordination guards in place:** wallet-spine checks #2871 for active `@codex` pushes before touching the branch (and reports instead of fighting it); the three lanes don't share files; and each runs the codex design/review gates required for this campaign. [...] > **Do not scaffold `nmp-wallet` — it already exists on branch `codex/2864-wallet-phase1-slice` (PR #2871, WIP draft).** Check out and build on that branch. First confirm no other agent is actively pushing it (it's a live WIP); if it is, coordinate/hand off rather than double-committing.
